sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vintage Gold Green Square Dial Mesh Bracelet Watch
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Give your everyday look a sophisticated upgrade with this Vintage Gold Green Square Dial Mesh Bracelet Watch, featuring a rich green dial, elegant detailing and a sleek gold-tone mesh bracelet.
The structured square dial gives the watch a chic retro-inspired appearance, while the fine mesh strap adds a delicate and polished finish. Its versatile design makes it perfect for styling with both western and traditional outfits.
Product Highlights
-
✨ Vintage-inspired square dial watch
-
💛 Elegant gold-tone finish
-
💚 Rich green dial
-
🔗 Fine mesh bracelet strap
-
⌚ Quartz movement
-
💎 Chic jewellery-inspired design
-
👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
-
✨ Elegant everyday accessory
-
🎁 Ideal gifting option for women
-
💫 Suitable for casual and special occasions
Perfect For
Office wear, college, casual outings, brunches, festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
